key: A friend (the retriever) flips to the
name: ch06_open_book_exam_friend
alt: A student writes an exam answer while a friend beside her places five open textbook pages on her desk.
scene: A slightly elevated three-quarter view of an Indian college exam hall during an open-book exam: rows of wooden benches, a ceiling fan, a blackboard reading "OPEN BOOK" and a wall clock at half past ten. In the foreground centre a bright student in her early 20s, plait over one shoulder, white salwar kameez with a dupatta, sits with pen poised over an answer sheet, confident but clearly not remembering exact numbers: a small thought bubble above her head shows a blurred number with a question mark. Standing beside her bench is her friend, a lanky young man in a striped half-sleeve shirt and spectacles, holding a fat textbook open and quickly laying five loose pages fanned out on her desk; a dotted arrow runs from the thick book on the shelf behind him, through his hands, to the five pages. Each page shows a highlighted table row so the right facts stand out. A second faint inset at the right edge shows the same student writing fast and smiling, an arrow leading from the five pages into her written answer. In the background, other students bend over their own books and an invigilator in a grey cardigan strolls between rows. Even, bright daylight from tall windows, focused and calm mood. Labels: "RETRIEVER" under the friend's feet, "MODEL" under the student's bench, "CONTEXT" above the five pages.

key: A huge context window is the huge phone
name: ch06_phone_gallery_search_bar
alt: A man scrolls endlessly through thousands of phone photos on one side, while on the other he types into a search bar and finds his ID card photo instantly.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, the same man in both halves: early 30s, neat moustache, maroon polo shirt, sitting on a plastic chair outside a government office with a form on a clipboard on his knee. LEFT panel: he holds his phone close, thumb flicking upward, and an enormous ribbon of tiny photo thumbnails pours out of the screen and spirals up into the sky like a never-ending scroll (wedding pictures, memes, sunsets, food plates, forwarded greetings); his face is tired and sweaty, a small clock icon beside him shows a long wait, and a clerk at the window behind taps his pen impatiently. RIGHT panel: the same man calmly types two letters into a search bar at the top of his phone screen, drawn large as an inset bubble, and a single thumbnail of a plain ID card (no readable number, just a face square and grey lines) pops up highlighted with a green tick; he smiles and holds the phone up to the clerk, who nods. A large storage cylinder icon floats behind the left panel, a magnifying glass icon behind the right. Bright midday light, relieved mood on the right. Labels: "BIG CONTEXT" at the top of the left panel, "RAG SEARCH" at the top of the right panel.

key: row of 50,000 light switches in a giant
name: ch06_switch_hall_mixing_desk
alt: Three panels: a vast hall of light switches with one lit, a sound mixing desk with every knob set, and the switch hall again with a few dozen switches glowing at different brightness.
scene: A wide triptych of three tall panels separated by thin vertical lines. LEFT panel: an enormous dim hall like an old railway shed, its long wall covered edge to edge with thousands of identical white light switches receding into the distance; exactly one switch is flipped on and a single bulb above it glows yellow, while a small electrician in a khaki uniform with a torch stands far away looking tiny. MIDDLE panel: a sound engineer in her late 20s, headphones around her neck, black kurta, leaning over a wide studio mixing desk covered in hundreds of round knobs and sliders, every single one set to some different level, little glowing level meters dancing above them; her hand rests on one slider, adjusting it gently. RIGHT panel: the same giant switch hall, but now a few dozen scattered switches are on, their bulbs glowing at different brightnesses, some strong and some faint, and a couple of the lit bulbs hang over switches whose nameplates are blank, as if lit for words nobody actually spoke; the electrician looks up surprised. Moody blue shadows in the halls, warm studio glow in the middle. Labels: "ONE-HOT" at the top of the left panel, "DENSE" at the top of the middle panel, "SPLADE" at the top of the right panel.

key: is in every sentence, so hearing it
name: ch06_local_train_rare_word
alt: Commuters in a crowded local train ignore the repeated word station in an announcement but look up sharply when a rare station name is called.
scene: Inside a packed Mumbai suburban local train compartment at evening rush hour, seen from the doorway looking down the aisle: steel grab handles, yellow-green seats, a ceiling fan, commuters standing shoulder to shoulder. A loudspeaker grille on the ceiling emits a stream of speech bubbles. Most bubbles are faded and grey, each repeating the same word "station" over and over, drifting past the passengers who ignore them: an office worker in a white shirt dozes against the pole, a college girl with earphones stares at her phone, a fruit seller with a basket looks out of the door. One bubble, however, is bold, bright orange and larger than the rest, containing the rare stop name "DADAR"; it hits a middle-aged man in a grey safari suit with a briefcase who snaps alert, eyebrows raised, already shuffling towards the door. Inset at the top right: a small dial gauge like a surprise meter, its needle low beside the grey word and pinned high beside the orange word. A second small inset shows a newspaper page with one word printed many times in thick ink, to suggest how loudly a document repeats a word. Warm tungsten light mixed with orange sunset through the open doors. Labels: "IDF" beside the surprise meter, "TF" beside the newspaper inset.

key: BM25 is a smart teacher who says
name: ch06_textbook_index_bm25_teacher
alt: A teacher holds up a thin three-page chapter and a thick appendix, explaining that the short chapter is more about photosynthesis, while a textbook index lists page numbers.
scene: A bright Indian school classroom, viewed from the side of the front row. On the left, a large open textbook is propped on a stand showing its back-of-book index page; one entry is highlighted in yellow, "Photosynthesis 12, 47, 103", with three thin arrows leaping from the entry to three page tabs sticking out of the book. In the centre stands a smart biology teacher in her 40s, cotton saree with a green border, reading glasses pushed up on her head, chalk in hand. In her right hand she raises a slim three-page chapter with five small leaf icons stamped on it; in her left hand she lifts a thick, heavy appendix with eight leaf icons scattered thinly through its many pages. A balance scale on the desk in front of her tips clearly towards the thin chapter. On the right, three students in white school uniforms with blue ties watch, one nodding, one taking notes. On the blackboard behind, a simple sketch of a green leaf and the sun. Cheerful morning light from windows with a neem tree outside. Labels: "INVERTED INDEX" above the textbook, "BM25" above the teacher's head, "MORE RELEVANT" on the low side of the scale.

key: librarian who finds books by matching
name: ch06_two_librarians_keyword_semantic
alt: One librarian matches exact words on book spines while another, who has read everything, walks a reader to a shelf of books on the topic she means.
scene: A split-panel illustration inside an old public library with tall teak shelves, a rolling ladder and dusty sunbeams, divided by a thin vertical line. The same reader appears in both halves: a young woman in her mid 20s, denim jacket over a kurti, tote bag, holding a slip of paper with her question. LEFT panel: an elderly librarian with a magnifying glass and half-moon spectacles, grey sweater vest, runs his finger along book spines, matching letters one by one against the words on her slip; he pulls out only books whose spine shows the identical word, while a shelf of clearly relevant books with different titles sits ignored behind him, marked by a faint question mark. RIGHT panel: a younger librarian in her 30s, bun with a pencil through it, walks briskly beside the reader, gesturing towards a whole glowing shelf of books about the topic she means, even though their titles use different words; small thought bubbles above the librarian show she has read them all. A tiny comic inset in the right corner shows the same librarian handing over an armful of every kind of tax form, with the reader looking puzzled. Warm golden library light. Labels: "KEYWORD" at the top of the left panel, "EMBEDDING" at the top of the right panel.

key: first find your nearest two railway
name: ch06_nearest_neighbours_city_map
alt: Three ways to find the nearest people in a big city: measuring to everyone, checking only near two stations, and hopping through well-connected friends.
scene: A wide illustrated top-down map of a dense Indian coastal city with railway lines, stations shown as small red-roofed buildings, and thousands of tiny dot-people across neighbourhoods, split into three vertical strips by thin lines. In every strip a young man in a yellow T-shirt stands on a highlighted spot as the person searching. LEFT strip: from him, hundreds of thin measuring-tape lines radiate out to every dot-person in the city, a tangle that fills the strip; a small stopwatch icon shows a very long time. MIDDLE strip: two nearby station buildings glow, each with a dashed circle around it; only the dot-people inside those two circles are connected to him by short tape lines, and the rest of the city is greyed out. RIGHT strip: he phones a cheerful well-connected aunty with a big network of lines around her, who points to an uncle a bit closer, who points to a student closer still, a chain of curved hop arrows spiralling towards the three nearest dot-people, which are highlighted in green. Clear daytime map colours: blue sea, beige streets, green parks. Labels: "K-NN" at the top of the left strip, "IVF" at the top of the middle strip, "HNSW" at the top of the right strip.

key: Precision: of the 10 dishes shown, how
name: ch06_paneer_search_precision_recall
alt: A man looks at ten dish results on his phone, some with paneer and some without, while a huge city map behind him hides many paneer dishes that never made it to his list.
scene: A two-part composition. FOREGROUND left: a hungry young man in his late 20s, sitting cross-legged on a sofa in shorts and a faded T-shirt, holds a phone showing a food-delivery search for paneer; the phone screen is drawn large as an inset bubble with ten dish cards in a list. Seven cards show golden paneer cubes and a green tick; three cards show a plate of plain noodles, a dosa and a chicken roll with red crosses. He is counting on his fingers, looking satisfied. BACKGROUND right: a huge glowing panorama of the city at dusk with hundreds of restaurant rooftops, and above many of them float little paneer dish icons; a dotted funnel leads from only a handful of those rooftops into his phone list, while most paneer icons remain out in the city, unseen. Standing on a rooftop in the background is a cartoon figure of an all-knowing food critic with a giant ledger of every menu, the only one who could count them all. Evening light, warm lamp in the room, purple city sky. Labels: "PRECISION" next to the phone inset with its ticks and crosses, "RECALL" over the city panorama of missed paneer dishes.

key: Writing down only names (simple index)
name: ch06_wedding_guest_list_index
alt: A caterer struggles with a names-only guest list at a wedding, while another caterer with a detailed list finds a guest instantly after a long night of writing.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: at a crowded wedding lawn with fairy lights and round tables, a flustered caterer in his 40s in a white chef jacket holds a short scrawled list of names only, scanning a crowd of a dozen uncles who all look alike in kurtas and bandhgala jackets; thought bubbles above him say "Pune?" and "veg?" with question marks; a waiter waits beside him with a covered veg plate, unsure where to go. Quickly written, the thin list has a little clock showing it took five minutes. RIGHT panel, split into top and bottom: TOP, the night before, the same caterer sits at a desk under a lamp at two in the morning, yawning, filling a long ledger with neat columns: name, city, a leaf symbol for diet, and a table number; a pile of chai glasses shows the long effort. BOTTOM, on the wedding day, he glances once at the ledger and points straight to table 7 where a smiling vegetarian uncle from Pune sits, the waiter already walking there with the plate. Warm night colours on the left, desk lamp glow at top right, cheerful daylight at bottom right. Labels: "SIMPLE INDEX" at the top of the left panel, "DETAILED INDEX" at the top of the right panel.

key: Choosing a restaurant from two friends
name: ch06_two_friends_top5_rrf
alt: Two friends each hold up a top-five restaurant list; in one panel one friend filters for the other, in the other the place ranked high on both lists wins.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, the same three friends in both halves, sitting at a roadside chai table in the evening: the decider in the middle, a young woman in a mustard kurta holding a cutting chai; on her left a practical friend in office shirt and lanyard; on her right a foodie friend with a round belly, a food-stained T-shirt and a notepad. LEFT panel: the practical friend hands a short list of places near the station to the foodie, who circles the best one with a pen; an arrow flows from the first friend's list into the foodie's hand and then to a single star. RIGHT panel: both friends hold up their own numbered top-five cards side by side, each with five small restaurant icons; a matching green thread links one restaurant that is number two on one card and number two on the other, and a golden crown floats above that place, even though each card's number one is a different restaurant; small rank numbers turn into little points added together in a bubble. Background of a busy street with restaurant signboards and scooters, warm street lights. Labels: "SEQUENCE" at the top of the left panel, "PARALLEL RRF" at the top of the right panel.

key: newspaper vendor sorting today
name: ch06_newspaper_vendor_rerank
alt: A newspaper vendor first pulls every paper mentioning election from a heap, then stacks today's edition on top and last week's at the bottom.
scene: An early-morning street-corner newspaper stall in an Indian town, seen from the front at eye level: a tarpaulin roof, strings of magazines hanging on clips, a bicycle with a bundle carrier leaning nearby. The vendor, a wiry man in his 50s with a grey stubble, white vest and checked lungi, a pencil behind his ear, works in two steps shown left to right. LEFT: from a huge messy heap of assorted newspapers on a gunny sack, he quickly yanks out every paper that has a bold headline word "ELECTION", tossing others aside; a fast motion blur and a small fan icon suggest a cheap quick pass. RIGHT: he arranges the chosen papers into a neat pile on his wooden counter, sliding today's crisp edition onto the top and older yellowed editions from last week to the bottom, with small calendar tags sticking out showing today at the top. A customer in his 60s in a cardigan, holding a steel glass of chai, takes a paper from near the top of the pile without fussing which one exactly. Soft dawn light, mist, a stray dog asleep under the counter. Labels: "RETRIEVE" over the heap on the left, "RERANK" over the neat pile on the right.

key: The rewriter is the person who turns
name: ch06_tea_stall_query_rewriter
alt: At a tea stall, a man says same for him; a helper standing between the customers and a newly arrived assistant turns it into the full chai order.
scene: A busy roadside tea stall at mid-morning, viewed from the side: a kettle on a kerosene stove, rows of glass cups, biscuit jars, a small steel counter. On the left, two office friends in their late 20s stand at the counter; one, in a blue shirt, points at the other with his thumb and says in a speech bubble "same for him". Behind the counter on the far right is a brand-new helper boy of about 17, in a fresh apron, looking blank and confused, with a question mark above his head because he did not hear the earlier order. In the middle stands the experienced chaiwala in his 40s, moustache, towel on shoulder, acting as the translator: a speech bubble from him to the new boy contains a small drawing of a half glass of chai with a small sugar cube crossed out, labelled in words "cutting, less sugar". A dotted arrow runs from the vague "same for him" bubble, through the chaiwala's head, into the full order bubble. A little memory cloud above the chaiwala shows the earlier order being placed. Morning sunlight, steam curling, crows on the wire above. Labels: "VAGUE QUERY" above the friends, "REWRITER" under the chaiwala, "SEARCH" under the new helper.

key: Which case? Which appellant? Writing
name: ch06_court_photocopy_context_label
alt: A clerk writes a header naming the case and page at the top of a lone photocopied judgment page so it can be found later.
scene: A cluttered photocopy and typing shop just outside a district court, seen at desk height: a big cream photocopier humming in the background, bundles of legal papers tied with red tape, a ceiling fan, notices on the wall. In the foreground on the counter lies a single photocopied page, a dense block of grey text lines with one sentence underlined. A young lawyer's clerk in his mid 20s, white shirt, black trousers, ID card on a lanyard, leans over it with a fat marker and is writing a neat header strip across the top that reads "CASE 1182, P.47". To the left, a second identical-looking loose page without any header floats in a little inset bubble, surrounded by question marks and three faint folder icons, showing that nobody could tell which case it belonged to. To the right, an advocate in a black coat and white bands, in her 40s, takes the labelled page and smiles as she drops it straight into the correct numbered file box. A dotted arrow runs from the header strip to the file box. Late afternoon light through dusty glass, busy but orderly mood. Labels: "CHUNK" beside the photocopied text, "CONTEXT" pointing at the handwritten header strip.

key: Renting a godown (warehouse) for your
name: ch06_godown_rental_vector_db
alt: A business owner inspects a warehouse for rent, checking goods it can hold, its size, truck bays, stocking time, picking speed and rent.
scene: A wide view of a large rental godown on the edge of an Indian industrial area, rolling shutter raised, interior lit by tube lights showing tall steel racks, some stacked with sacks, cartons and drums, others empty. In the foreground centre a young business owner in his early 30s, half-sleeve checked shirt, jeans, pen behind his ear, holds a clipboard checklist and inspects the place, with a portly broker in his 50s in a white kurta and gold watch gesturing grandly beside him. Around the scene, five small inset bubbles with simple icons are connected by dotted lines to the relevant spots: one beside the racks showing sacks, boxes and drums (what goods it can handle); one beside the measuring tape across the floor and the loading bay where three trucks wait in line to unload (size and trucks per hour); one beside workers stacking sacks with an hourglass (time to stock); one beside a picker with a trolley sprinting down an aisle with a stopwatch (how fast an order is picked); and one beside the broker showing a rupee coin with a ruler and a truck to suggest rent per square foot or per visit. Bright afternoon light, dust in the beams, practical mood. Labels: "GODOWN" above the shutter, "CHECKLIST" on the clipboard.

key: assistant who has looked at every photo
name: ch06_wedding_photo_archive_search
alt: A wedding photographer's assistant finds the photo of the groom on a horse among thousands of uncaptioned prints, while file-name searching fails.
scene: A small wedding photography studio in an Indian city, walls covered with framed portraits of brides and grooms, a desk with two monitors and stacks of hard disks. Composition left to right in three parts. LEFT: a tired studio owner in his 40s, kurta and waistcoat, stares at a screen full of meaningless file names, a speech bubble with "IMG_4521" and a frowning face. MIDDLE: a cardboard box overflowing with printed photos, some with handwritten captions on the back like "haldi", most with nothing written at all. RIGHT: a bright young assistant in her early 20s, short hair, studio T-shirt with a camera strap around her neck, confidently reaches into a towering wall of thousands of photo thumbnails and pulls out exactly one: a groom in a cream sherwani and red safa sitting on a decorated white horse in a baraat, with a golden glow around it. Small dotted lines connect her eyes to many thumbnails, showing she has looked at every photo. A customer, the bride's mother in a silk saree, beams as she receives the print. Warm studio lighting with a softbox in the corner. Labels: "FILE NAME" above the left monitor, "IMAGE SEARCH" above the assistant.

key: he opens Tally, runs a report (SQL)
name: ch06_ca_ledger_report_text_to_sql
alt: A chartered accountant runs a report on accounting software and tells a client the quarterly GST total in one line.
scene: A neat chartered accountant's cabin in an Indian town, seen at a three-quarter angle: a wooden desk, a desktop computer, a calculator, box files labelled by year on a steel shelf, a calendar with a small festival picture. On the left sits the client, a shop owner in his 50s in a cream shirt and a gold ring, leaning forward anxiously with a speech bubble containing a small rupee sign and a question mark. In the centre the CA, a calm woman in her 40s with short grey-streaked hair, a cotton saree and a pen in hand, does not reach for the towering pile of paper invoices on the side table, which is greyed out with a cross; instead she clicks on her computer, where an inset bubble shows a short query card turning into a tidy report table with one bold total row. A dotted arrow flows from the client's question, into the computer, out to the report, and then to a short speech bubble from the CA holding a single number with a small rupee sign. The client relaxes, smiling. Soft fluorescent office light, a cup of filter coffee steaming. Labels: "SQL" on the query card in the inset, "ANSWER" above the CA's short reply bubble.

key: Hiring a new junior assistant. Huge
name: ch06_new_junior_assistant_agent
alt: A manager watches closely over the shoulder of a new junior assistant who is juggling travel bookings, vendor calls and spreadsheets.
scene: A small modern office in an Indian startup, open-plan desks, plants, a whiteboard with sticky notes. In the centre, an eager junior assistant in his early 20s, round glasses, a crisp new shirt with the shop tag barely removed, juggles several tasks at once, drawn playfully with floating icons around him: a train ticket, a phone ringing with a vendor, a spreadsheet with green cells, a calendar. He looks capable and keen, typing fast on a laptop. Directly behind him, leaning over his shoulder, stands the manager, a woman in her late 30s in a blazer and kurta, arms folded, eyes narrowed in close attention, holding a blank clipboard titled with a big question mark because no checklist exists yet for this kind of assistant. On the whiteboard behind, an empty page labelled "manual" has only a question mark. To the right, a coffee mug and a sticky note reading "week 1". Bright, optimistic office light with a hint of nervousness. Labels: "AGENT" under the junior assistant's desk, "WATCH CLOSELY" next to the manager.

key: delivery partner is an agent.
name: ch06_delivery_rider_agent_environment
alt: A food delivery rider weaves through city roads, picking up, riding, calling and delivering, while a cycle rider is stopped at a highway entrance.
scene: A wide, slightly aerial illustrated view of an Indian city neighbourhood at lunchtime, laid out like a game board: restaurants with awnings on the left, a tangle of narrow gullies in the middle, apartment blocks on the right, and a fast six-lane highway running along the top edge. In the foreground a food delivery rider in his mid 20s, orange jacket, helmet, insulated box on the back of his scooter, appears four times along a curving dotted route, each with a small action icon: picking up a sealed bag at a restaurant counter, riding through a gully, pausing to call a customer on his phone, handing over the bag at a doorway with a tick. Along the route, ten small numbered decision diamonds sit at junctions, most green, one turned red with a little wrong-turn arrow. At the top left a second rider on a bicycle is stopped by a barrier at the highway on-ramp, looking frustrated, showing that his vehicle limits where he can go. Bright noon sun, busy cheerful street life: vegetable carts, autos, a cow resting in the shade. Labels: "ENVIRONMENT" across the city map at the top right, "ACTIONS" beside the four action icons, "AGENT" next to the scooter rider in the foreground.

key: access to the company wiki (retriever)
name: ch06_new_employee_tool_access
alt: A new employee at a desk is handed keys to a wiki, staff directory, chat history and inventory screen, while a flood of junk forwards pours in from an open internet window.
scene: A cheerful open office in an Indian tech company, seen from slightly above a new employee's desk. The new hire, a young woman in her early 20s with a ponytail, formal white shirt and fresh ID lanyard, sits at a laptop, smiling with growing confidence. Around her a team lead in a polo shirt hands over a ring of four large symbolic keys, each tag showing a simple icon: a book for the company wiki, a people icon for the staff directory, a chat bubble for message history, and a bar chart for the inventory dashboard. Each key connects by a glowing line to a small window floating above her laptop, showing that same resource opening up. A lightbulb brightens over her head. On the right side of the desk a fifth window, drawn as a wide open browser, spills a messy stream of junk forwards into her lap: a glittery good-morning flower card, a fake miracle cure flyer, a chain message with many exclamation marks, and one sneaky note reading "ignore your boss". Her expression there is slightly doubtful. Soft daylight from big windows, potted plants, a whiteboard behind. Labels: "TOOLS" above the ring of keys, "SAME BRAIN" over the employee's head, "JUNK" beside the overflowing browser window.

key: Giving your driver the car keys (write
name: ch06_driver_keys_read_write_access
alt: An owner lets the driver check the fuel gauge freely, hands over car keys cautiously, and keeps a phone PIN entirely to himself.
scene: A residential driveway outside an Indian apartment building in the morning, with a parked white sedan and a watchman's cabin in the background. Composition in three zones from left to right. LEFT: the family driver, a man in his 40s in a pressed white uniform shirt and cap, leans through the open car window to glance at the fuel gauge on the dashboard, shown enlarged in an inset bubble with the needle at three-quarters; a green open padlock floats beside him to show this is always allowed. MIDDLE: the owner, a man in his 50s in a crisp kurta and sandals, holding a newspaper under his arm, cautiously hands the car keys to the driver, the keys glowing amber, with a small handshake icon and a calendar showing trust earned over months. RIGHT: the owner turns away and shields his phone screen with his hand, a payment PIN pad drawn in an inset bubble behind a thick red padlock; the driver politely looks the other way. Morning sunlight, long shadows, a calm and practical mood. Labels: "READ" above the fuel gauge inset, "WRITE" above the keys handover, "NEVER" above the locked PIN pad.

key: The architect (planner) draws the plan
name: ch06_house_renovation_plan_execute
alt: An architect drafts a renovation plan, a municipal approver checks it, a contractor executes it, and the owner signs off before a load-bearing wall is broken.
scene: A cutaway view of an older two-storey Indian house under renovation, bamboo scaffolding outside, bags of cement and a pile of bricks in the yard, arranged as a left-to-right flow with thick arrows. LEFT: an architect in her 30s, kurta and jeans, pencil behind her ear, bends over a drawing board with a blueprint of the house. NEXT: a stern municipal approver in his 50s in a beige safari suit at a cluttered desk with a rubber stamp, holding the blueprint up; one version has a red stamp and a note bubble showing an hourglass and a crossed-out material sack, the corrected version gets a green stamp. NEXT: a contractor in a hard hat and vest, with two workers carrying a ladder and a mason's trowel, begins work on the house; after each stage a small loop arrow curves back to the architect who inspects with a tape measure. RIGHT: at a thick central wall marked with an X in chalk, the homeowner, a retired man in a cardigan and spectacles, signs a paper on a clipboard before the worker is allowed to swing a sledgehammer. Dusty afternoon light, busy but orderly. Labels: "PLANNER" above the architect, "EVALUATOR" above the approver, "EXECUTOR" above the contractor.

key: Planning a route through Old Delhi
name: ch06_old_city_lanes_planning
alt: A well-read guide describes the old city beautifully but leads into a closed lane, while a practical walker backtracks and tries the next lane.
scene: A bird's-eye illustrated maze of narrow old-city lanes in an Indian walled city, crowded with overhanging balconies, tangled electric wires, cycle rickshaws, spice sacks and tiny shops. Split into two halves by a thin vertical line. LEFT half: a scholarly guide in his 60s with a white beard, round spectacles, a stack of guidebooks under one arm, waves his hand poetically describing the beautiful old havelis, speech bubbles full of little dome and lantern icons; his confident dotted path leads a tourist couple straight into a lane blocked by a fallen wooden barrier and a "CLOSED" board, and the couple look puzzled. RIGHT half: a practical young local woman in her 20s with a backpack and sneakers walks the same maze; her path is drawn as a dotted line that enters one lane, hits the closed barrier, curves back with a small U-turn arrow, then tries the next lane and reaches the destination, a bright spice-market square with a green tick. Small signposts at each junction show where each turn leads. Warm late-afternoon light filtering between buildings. Labels: "DESCRIBES" over the left half, "PLANS" over the right half.

key: Your mother hands you a shopping list
name: ch06_mother_shopping_list_parameters
alt: A mother hands her son a short shopping list at the door; at the market he decides quantities after seeing prices, but stares puzzled at a vague line about the usual sweets.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: the doorway of a modest Indian home in the morning, a mother in her 50s in a cotton nightie with a dupatta, hair in a bun, hands a short handwritten list and a cloth shopping bag to her son, a college student in a T-shirt and track pants with a scooter key. The list, shown enlarged in an inset, has three short lines: "vegetables", "dal", "oil", and a fourth line "the usual sweets" with no details. RIGHT panel: a lively vegetable and grocery market, the same son standing at a stall with heaps of tomatoes, onions and greens, looking at price boards; small thought bubbles show him deciding quantities after seeing prices and freshness, like picking fewer tomatoes because they look soft and more onions because they are cheap. At the sweet shop counter behind him, a glass case of a dozen kinds of sweets, laddoos, barfi, jalebi, and he scratches his head with a big question mark over him. Morning sunlight, busy colourful mood. Labels: "PLAN" above the list inset in the left panel, "PARAMETERS" beside the price boards on the right, "AMBIGUOUS" over the sweet shop case.

key: The menu card is the tool declaration
name: ch06_waiter_order_slip_function_call
alt: A diner writes an order slip from a menu card, a waiter carries it through the kitchen door, and a plate comes back.
scene: A cross-section view of a small Indian restaurant, the dining room on the left and the kitchen on the right, separated by a swinging door with a round window. LEFT: a diner, a woman in her 30s in a smart kurta with a handbag on the chair, studies a laminated menu card listing dishes with small tick-box options for spice and plates, then fills in a small order slip that reads "paneer tikka, 2". She stays firmly in her seat and never goes into the kitchen. CENTRE: a waiter in a black vest and bow tie, notepad in pocket, carries the slip through the swinging door, a dotted arrow showing its path. RIGHT: inside a busy kitchen with a tandoor glowing orange, a cook in a white cap reads the slip pinned on a rail and places skewers into the tandoor; a second dotted arrow brings a finished sizzling plate back out to the diner's table. Above the menu card, three small tabs read "auto", "required" and "none" with tiny icons of a chef's hat, an exclamation mark and a crossed-out plate. Warm restaurant lighting on the left, bright kitchen light on the right. Labels: "TOOL LIST" above the menu card, "CALL" on the order slip, "RESULT" above the returning plate.

key: If Sharma Caterers changes its number
name: ch06_wedding_planner_phone_book
alt: A wedding planner writes a high-level plan on a board while her assistant translates each step into specific phone calls using a phone book.
scene: A busy wedding planner's office in an Indian city, marigold garlands hanging in samples, fabric swatches and a big whiteboard. LEFT: the planner, a confident woman in her 40s in a silk kurta with a pen and a headset around her neck, stands at the whiteboard where three high-level steps are written as big bullet points with icons: a cooking pot, a flower arch and an envelope. CENTRE: a dotted arrow leads from the cooking pot bullet to her assistant, a young man in his mid 20s with a crisp shirt and lanyard, who sits at a desk with a thick dog-eared phone book open and a desk phone to his ear; above him a thought bubble turns the cooking pot icon into a specific caterer's shop card with a phone handset icon. RIGHT: an inset shows a single page of the phone book being updated, an old number crossed out and a new one written in, while the whiteboard plan above stays untouched, highlighted by a small padlock. A wall calendar with a big circled wedding date hangs behind. Bright daytime office light, organised and busy mood. Labels: "PLAN" above the whiteboard, "TRANSLATOR" under the assistant's desk.

key: Parallel: rice, dal and sabzi cook on
name: ch06_thali_kitchen_control_flow
alt: A home cook makes a thali in four ways at once: heating oil before tadka, three burners in parallel, skipping onion for a guest, and rolling rotis until everyone says enough.
scene: A wide view of a busy home kitchen in an Indian house during a family lunch, divided into four quadrants by faint dotted lines, the same cook in each: a cheerful woman in her 40s in a cotton saree with the pallu tucked at the waist, bangles, a ladle in hand. TOP LEFT: she waits beside a kadhai of heating oil, a small clock and a "1 then 2" arrow showing she must heat the oil before adding mustard seeds. TOP RIGHT: three burners blaze at once with a pressure cooker of rice, a pot of dal and a pan of sabzi, all bubbling simultaneously, three parallel arrows above them. BOTTOM LEFT: a guest at the dining table wears a small badge with a leaf symbol, and she pushes a bowl of chopped onions aside, a fork in the path diagram showing one branch skipped. BOTTOM RIGHT: she rolls and puffs rotis on a tawa in a circular loop arrow, while family members at the table hold out plates until one uncle finally raises his palm and says "bas!" in a speech bubble, ending the loop. Warm lunch-time light, steam rising, cheerful mood. Labels: "PARALLEL" top right, "IF" bottom left, and "LOOP" bottom right.

key: A student who failed a mock exam. The
name: ch06_mock_exam_self_reflection
alt: A teacher marks a failed mock exam, the student writes a lesson about units in a notebook, and on the next attempt he writes units everywhere.
scene: A three-step left-to-right sequence in a coaching class in an Indian town, joined by curved arrows. LEFT: a physics teacher in her 50s, cotton saree and spectacles on a chain, sits at a desk marking an answer sheet with a red pen; several answers have red circles around numbers missing their units, and a low score in a circle at the top. MIDDLE: the student, a lanky teenage boy in a school uniform with untucked shirt, sits on the steps outside the class looking thoughtful, writing in a small spiral notebook; the page is shown enlarged in an inset with a short line "always write units" and a little lightbulb doodle. RIGHT: in the next exam, the same boy, now sitting upright and confident, writes answers where every number is followed by a unit, highlighted with small green ticks, his notebook peeking out of his pocket. A dotted arrow loops from the notebook back to the new answer sheet, showing the lesson carried forward. Afternoon light through barred windows, ceiling fan, blackboard with formulas in the background. Labels: "EVALUATOR" above the teacher, "REFLECTION" above the notebook, "NEW TRY" above the final answer sheet.

key: Carry every tool in the shop and you
name: ch06_plumber_bag_tool_selection
alt: A plumber digs through an overstuffed bag that will not close, while a wiser plumber carries a small neat bag and leaves unused tools in the van.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, set in the narrow service corridor of an Indian apartment building with exposed pipes and a dripping valve. LEFT panel: a harried plumber in his 40s, blue overalls and rubber slippers, kneels beside a burst pipe, rummaging elbow-deep in an enormous overstuffed tool bag whose zip strains open; spanners, pliers, saws, drills, coils of pipe and odd gadgets spill everywhere, and sweat beads fly off his forehead while water sprays; the bag's zip is visibly broken. RIGHT panel: a calm, experienced plumber in his 50s with a grey moustache and a neat khaki uniform carries a small tidy bag with just five well-used tools, already tightening the joint with the right spanner. Behind him, through the building's gate, his parked van is visible with its back doors open, showing racks of rarely used tools left behind, each with a cobweb or dust mark, and a small notebook on the van seat with tally marks for tools used. Soft daylight from a window, dripping water sparkles. Labels: "EVERY TOOL" at the top of the left panel, "FEW TOOLS" at the top of the right panel, "LEFT IN VAN" beside the van.

key: He pre-mixes leaves and sugar into one
name: ch06_chaiwala_premix_recipe_card
alt: A chaiwala merges two steps by pre-mixing tea leaves and sugar in one jar, and pins a recipe card on the wall for tomorrow's helper.
scene: A tiny roadside tea stall at dawn, seen from the customer's side. On the left, the chaiwala, a lean man in his 40s with a grey sweater over a vest, a towel on his shoulder, pours tea leaves and sugar together from two separate tins into one big steel jar, shaking it; above him a simple step diagram shows four small icons (water, leaves, sugar, milk), with the leaves and sugar icons merging into a single combined icon so only three steps remain. On the right side of the stall, he pins a hand-written index card to the wooden post with a thumb tack; the card shows the three steps as tiny drawings with arrows. A teenage helper boy in an oversized jacket arrives the next morning, shown in a small inset at the top right with a sunrise, reading the card and copying the steps confidently with a saucepan. At the edge of the frame, one customer in a tracksuit raises a hand with a crossed-out sugar cube in a speech bubble, a small cloud of trouble over the pre-mix jar. Soft orange dawn light, steam rising from the kettle. Labels: "MERGED TOOL" on the jar, "SKILL CARD" on the pinned recipe card.

key: A travel agent who books a train that
name: ch06_travel_agent_failure_modes
alt: A flustered travel agent makes six kinds of booking mistakes shown around him, then cheerfully says all done.
scene: A cramped travel agency office in an Indian town, posters of hill stations on the walls, a ceiling fan, a desktop computer and a ticket printer. In the centre sits a travel agent in his 30s with gelled hair, a shiny shirt and a gold chain, grinning and giving a thumbs-up, with a speech bubble saying "all done!". Around him, like a ring of comic thought clouds, six small vignettes show what really happened: a train ticket for a phantom train that fades into mist; a booking form with a date typed into the name box; a printed ticket showing three passenger figures while the family waiting has four people, one child left out; a little map with a route to the wrong city marked by a red X while a pin sits on the right one; a wall clock past the window time beside a closed shutter; and finally the agent's own thumbs-up bubble with a crack in it. In front of the desk a family of four, a father in a shirt, a mother in a saree, two children, look increasingly alarmed. Warm cluttered office light, comic but clear mood. Labels: "PLANNING ERRORS" arching above the ring of vignettes, "REFLECTION ERROR" beside the cracked thumbs-up bubble.

key: route that is technically correct but
name: ch06_map_route_every_signal
alt: A navigation map shows two routes to the same destination, one zigzagging through every traffic signal, and a road the map thinks is closed.
scene: A top-down illustrated city map of an Indian metro filling most of the frame, with roads, flyovers, a river and landmarks such as a temple and a stadium. A start pin sits at the bottom left and a destination pin at the top right. Route one is drawn as a long winding red line that zigzags through the whole city, passing through about a dozen traffic signals, each drawn as a small red light icon with a tiny queue of cars and autos; it still ends at the destination with a tick. Route two is a short smooth green line along a wide road straight to the destination. On the green road, a big orange barrier icon is drawn incorrectly over an open road where cars are actually moving freely, showing the map itself is wrong. In the bottom right corner, a car interior inset shows a tired driver in his 30s with a cab ID badge, staring at a phone mount, sighing, with a fuel gauge and a coin counter falling. Clean daylight map colours. Labels: "VALID BUT SLOW" along the red zigzag route, "EFFICIENT" along the green route, "TOOL FAILURE" beside the wrong barrier.

key: Medical training is internal knowledge
name: ch06_doctor_three_memories
alt: A doctor in a clinic draws on her training, notes from the current conversation, and a patient file fetched from the records room.
scene: A busy clinic consultation room in an Indian hospital, seen at a three-quarter angle. In the centre, a calm doctor in her 40s, white coat over a printed kurta, stethoscope around her neck, sits at a desk listening to an elderly patient, a man in his 70s in a muffler and sweater, who gestures while describing symptoms. Three kinds of memory are drawn around her. ABOVE her head: a large thought cloud with stacked medical textbooks and a graduation cap, fixed and solid. ON THE DESK: a small notepad on which she scribbles quick notes from the last few minutes, a little five-minute timer beside it. ON THE RIGHT: through an open doorway, a long corridor leads to a records room with tall shelves of files; a ward boy in a green uniform is bringing out one fat patient file with a name tag, a dotted arrow showing it being fetched only now. In the far corner of the records room, a shredder sits beside an old file being shredded, while the doctor's textbook cloud remains untouched. Clean fluorescent light, calm professional mood. Labels: "INTERNAL" on the thought cloud, "SHORT-TERM" on the notepad, "LONG-TERM" above the records room.

key: Your family doctor vs a different clinic
name: ch06_family_doctor_vs_new_clinics
alt: A family doctor with a neat file remembers a patient's allergy, while a chain of different clinics gives a patient a heap of papers and contradictory prescriptions.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, the same patient in both halves: a woman in her 30s in a cotton salwar suit with a handbag, sneezing slightly. LEFT panel: a cosy neighbourhood family doctor's clinic with a wooden desk, an old calendar and a jar of lollipops; a kindly grey-haired doctor in his 60s with a sweater vest opens a single tidy file with coloured tabs, points to a red allergy sticker inside and smiles, saying in a speech bubble a small crossed-out pill icon; the prescription he writes matches the previous month's, shown by two identical slips side by side with a green equal sign. RIGHT panel: the same patient walks down a road past three different clinic doors, each with a different young doctor; she clutches a messy heap of loose reports and receipts falling from her arms, and the three doctors hand her three prescriptions that contradict each other, one with the very pill crossed out on the left, linked by red not-equal signs; she looks confused. Warm light on the left, cold and hurried light on the right. Labels: "MEMORY" at the top of the left panel, "NO MEMORY" at the top of the right panel.

key: A small fridge in a hostel room
name: ch06_hostel_fridge_memory_management
alt: A student juggles a tiny hostel fridge and the mess cold store, losing a birthday cake to first-in-first-out, packing leftovers into a tiffin, and replacing old milk.
scene: A cutaway illustration of a college hostel. LEFT: a cramped hostel room with posters, a study table and a tiny bar fridge with its door open, stuffed full. A student in his early 20s, shorts and a college hoodie, is caught in three small actions around it, numbered with circles. One: a conveyor-style arrow pushes the oldest item out of the back of the fridge, and it is a birthday cake box with candles, which the student watches in horror as it falls into a dustbin. Two: he scoops several half-eaten containers of rice, dal and sabzi into one stacked steel tiffin carrier. Three: holding a new milk packet, he compares it with an old one inside, with three little choice tags floating above, a plus sign, a merge symbol, and a swap arrow, and he swaps the old milk out. RIGHT: down the corridor, through a big steel door, the hostel mess cold store with rows of shelves and crates, where a mess worker in an apron stores items long term; a dotted arrow links the small fridge and the cold store. Warm tube-light glow, playful mood. Labels: "SHORT-TERM" above the small fridge, "LONG-TERM" above the cold store.

key: Prompting is handing them a detailed
name: ch07_new_hire_prompt_rag_finetune
alt: Three ways to help a new hire: an instruction sheet each morning, access to the company wiki, or a training course that builds habits.
scene: A triptych of three tall panels separated by thin vertical lines, the same new hire in each: a young man in his early 20s with neatly combed hair, a light blue formal shirt and a fresh ID lanyard, at a desk in an Indian office. LEFT panel: at nine in the morning, a supervisor in a grey blazer hands him a long instruction sheet; yesterday's identical crumpled sheets pile up in his dustbin, and he reads carefully with a finger on the page. MIDDLE panel: he sits at his laptop, the screen drawn as an inset showing a wiki page with headings and a search box, a glowing cable linking the laptop to a tall bookshelf of company binders behind him; he looks up a fact with a satisfied nod. RIGHT panel: he sits in a training room among other trainees, a trainer at a flip chart, and small habit icons (a smiling greeting, a neat checklist, a polite handshake) float from the flip chart into his head and settle there like glowing badges; a final small inset shows him back at his desk with no sheet at all, working confidently. Bright, optimistic office daylight. Labels: "PROMPT" at the top of the left panel, "RAG" at the top of the middle panel, "FINETUNE" at the top of the right panel.

key: A medical graduate (pre-trained) does
name: ch07_doctor_specialisation_ladder
alt: The same doctor climbs four steps from graduate to intern to cardiology resident to paediatric cardiology fellow, each step more specialised.
scene: A staircase of four broad steps rising from left to right across a hospital corridor background with pale green walls and a bench. On each step stands the same person at a different stage, a woman who ages slightly from 23 to her early 30s. STEP 1: fresh graduate in a black convocation gown and cap, holding a rolled degree, an open general medical textbook icon beside her. STEP 2: intern in a plain white coat over scrubs, a stethoscope and a clipboard, with small icons of a fever, a bandage and a bone around her showing general work. STEP 3: cardiology resident in a white coat with a heart badge, holding an ECG strip, a heart icon glowing larger. STEP 4: paediatric cardiology fellow kneeling beside a small boy of six on an examination stool, listening to his chest with a child-sized stethoscope, a teddy bear on the bed, a small heart with a toy balloon icon. A thin rising arrow runs along the steps, and the general icons from step 2 grow faint as she climbs higher. Soft clean hospital lighting, hopeful mood. Labels: "PRE-TRAINED" under step 1, "SFT" under step 2, "NARROW" under step 4.

key: A local tailor who only stitches school
name: ch07_school_uniform_tailor_specialist
alt: A neighbourhood tailor stitching school uniforms quickly and cheaply beats a famous designer's studio at the same job.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a small neighbourhood tailor shop in an Indian town, a single sewing machine by the window, shelves of identical navy-blue and white fabric rolls, racks of finished school shirts and shorts on hangers. A tailor in his 50s with a measuring tape around his neck and spectacles on his nose sews quickly, a stopwatch icon showing fast and a small rupee coin showing cheap. A mother and her son in a school uniform watch happily as the boy tries on a perfect-fitting shirt that matches a school spec sheet pinned to the wall. RIGHT panel: a glamorous designer studio with mannequins, spotlights, a velvet sofa and racks of embroidered gowns; a famous designer with sunglasses on his head and a scarf gestures dramatically over a school uniform while three assistants fuss around, a big price tag and an hourglass floating above, and the shirt looks overdesigned with a glittering collar. A small inset at the very bottom of the left panel shows the same humble tailor puzzled in front of a wedding sherwani. Warm light on the left, harsh glam spotlights on the right. Labels: "SMALL FINETUNED" at the top of the left panel, "BIG GENERAL" at the top of the right panel.

key: Buying a car vs taking an auto. A car
name: ch07_car_vs_auto_finetune_cost
alt: A man buying a car faces licence, parking, insurance and servicing costs, while his friend simply hails an auto-rickshaw.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, on the same busy Indian street with shops and a bus stop. LEFT panel: a young man in his late 20s, formal shirt and backpack, stands proudly beside a shiny new hatchback with a red ribbon on the bonnet, but around him float a ring of burdens with small icons: a driving licence card, a tight parking spot with a fence, an insurance document, a mechanic with a spanner and an oil can, and a calendar page showing next year with a newer car model teaser poster. He holds a long bill that unrolls to the ground. RIGHT panel: his friend, a young woman in a kurta and sneakers with a phone in hand, simply raises her arm and hails a yellow-and-black auto-rickshaw; the cheerful driver with a moustache leans out, meter running, a small coin icon showing a low fare, and she hops in, carefree. A tiny note in her hand shows a short destination scribbled on it which she can change anytime. Bright afternoon light, mild traffic haze. Labels: "FINETUNED MODEL" at the top of the left panel, "PROMPT + API" at the top of the right panel.

key: A big multi-speciality hospital vs a
name: ch07_clinic_vs_hospital_general_model
alt: A small specialist clinic's lone doctor watches as general physicians at a big hospital next door get better and handle his cases more accurately.
scene: A street scene in an Indian city showing two buildings side by side. LEFT: a small single-storey clinic with a hand-painted board showing a rupee symbol and a stethoscope, a narrow door and one chair outside; inside, a specialist doctor in his 50s in a tweed jacket sits alone, surrounded by stacks of ledgers and financial charts he spent years building, looking anxiously out of the window. A faded calendar on the clinic wall shows an older year. RIGHT: a tall, gleaming multi-speciality hospital with glass walls, an ambulance bay and a busy entrance; through big windows, a team of young general physicians in white coats are visible, and a staircase of growing arrows on the facade shows them improving each year. A queue of patients holding finance-related paperwork walks past the small clinic and into the big hospital, where a general doctor accurately diagnoses one with a green tick bubble. At the clinic's door, a safe with a padlock suggests the clinic keeps its own data in-house. Bright midday light, slightly bittersweet mood. Labels: "SPECIALIST" above the clinic, "GENERAL" above the hospital.

key: send them to soft-skills training
name: ch07_call_centre_rag_vs_finetune
alt: A call-centre agent looks at a live train-timing screen for facts, then attends soft-skills training to fix a rude tone.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, the same call-centre agent in both halves: a young woman in her mid 20s with a headset, a lanyard and a neat bun, sitting in a cubicle in a large Indian call centre with rows of desks and a big wall clock. LEFT panel: a caller's bubble asks about a train time; she turns to a second monitor showing a live timetable board with rows of trains and blinking times, and answers from it with a confident smile. A small inset shows tomorrow's board with different times, emphasising that facts keep changing. RIGHT panel: a training room with a whiteboard showing a smiley face, a handshake and a speech bubble with a greeting; a friendly trainer in a waistcoat role-plays a call with her, and she practises a warm greeting. In a thought bubble above her, a before-and-after: a frowning phone with a jagged speech line becomes a smiling phone with a smooth one. A crossed-out stack of timetable printouts lies in a bin next to the trainer, showing that memorising timings would be pointless. Bright fluorescent office light. Labels: "RAG FOR FACTS" at the top of the left panel, "FINETUNE FOR FORM" at the top of the right panel.

key: Fixing a slow kitchen: first give
name: ch07_kitchen_fix_ladder
alt: A restaurant manager fixes a kitchen step by step: clearer orders, photos of dishes, a recipe book, a better index, and finally training the cooks.
scene: A staircase-like progression across a busy Indian restaurant kitchen, shown left to right as five numbered stations along a steel counter, with the same manager walking along them: a woman in her late 30s in a black chef coat, hair in a net, holding a clipboard. Station 1: she pins up a clearly written order slip with big bold lines. Station 2: she tapes three glossy photos of finished dishes, a biryani, a dal makhani and a paneer plate, above the counter. Station 3: a recipe book stands open on a book stand beside the stove. Station 4: the recipe book now has colourful tabs and an index card box, and a cook flips quickly to the right page with the correct spice jars lined up. Station 5: two young cooks in white caps practise plating at a training table with the manager guiding their hands, adjusting portion size and garnish. Above the stations, a dashed arrow climbs upward with a small effort meter rising. Steam, copper pots and a tandoor glow in the background. Warm, busy, organised mood. Labels: "PROMPT" over station 1, "RAG" over station 3, and "FINETUNE" over station 5.

key: A cricket team reviewing a lost match
name: ch07_cricket_review_backprop
alt: A cricket coach reviews a lost match on a whiteboard, assigning different amounts of blame to each player and adjusting their training.
scene: A cricket team's dressing room after a lost match, seen from the doorway: wooden benches, kit bags, pads and helmets, a big scoreboard visible through the window showing the team lost by 40 runs. At the front a coach in his 50s, team tracksuit and cap, stands at a whiteboard with a marker. On the board, a row of eleven simple player stick figures, each with a blame bar above it of a different height: a tall red bar over a fielder who dropped a catch, a short bar over a batter who took a slow single, tiny bars over others. A thin line of arrows runs backwards from the scoreboard result through each player's bar, showing the blame flowing back. Beside the board, the coach's thick notebook is open with notes from many past matches, little arrows indicating he remembers trends. The players sit on benches in muddy whites: the fielder who dropped the catch hangs his head, the young batter fidgets with his gloves. To the right, a training schedule sheet shows extra catching drills in bold for one player and a light session for another. Late evening floodlight glow through the window. Labels: "LOSS" next to the scoreboard, "GRADIENT" above the blame bars, "OPTIMIZER" beside the coach.

key: The guests are the weights (fixed)
name: ch07_wedding_hall_memory_budget
alt: A wedding hall where fixed guests are the weights, and plates, chairs and counters scale with how many arrive at once and how long they eat.
scene: A wide, elevated view of a large Indian wedding banquet hall with chandeliers, marigold garlands and a stage in the background. In the centre, rows of seated guests in festive clothes, sarees, sherwanis and kurtas, form a fixed block that never moves, outlined by a soft golden border. Around them, the variable stuff spreads out: stacks of steel plates, rows of extra folding chairs, long serving counters with chafing dishes of biryani and paneer, and waiters carrying trays. At the left entrance, a fresh crowd of guests arrives in a big wave all at once, and the extra chairs and plates multiply around them. At the right, a dinner clock shows a long meal and the plates pile higher as courses keep coming. In the foreground, the hall manager, a man in his 40s in a black suit with a walkie-talkie, holds a booking sheet beside a floor plan showing the hall drawn a fifth larger than the guest block, with a small dashed margin around it. Warm chandelier light, festive bustle. Labels: "WEIGHTS" over the seated guest block, "ACTIVATIONS" over the plates and counters, "20% EXTRA" on the dashed margin of the floor plan.

key: Weights are the students. Gradients
name: ch07_exam_hall_training_memory
alt: An exam hall where each student has an answer sheet and two rough sheets, the blackboard is wiped and rewritten to save space, and some frozen students sit without sheets.
scene: A large Indian school exam hall seen from the back corner: rows of wooden desks, ceiling fans, high windows and a long blackboard at the front. Students in white uniforms sit at desks. On most desks lies one answer sheet plus two smaller rough sheets, each neatly stacked, so the desks look crowded with paper. A few students at the back are drawn with a faint blue frost tint and sit with empty desks, no sheets at all, looking calm. At the front, the blackboard is covered in chalk working that must stay up; a peon in a khaki uniform wipes part of it clean with a duster, while a small inset next to him shows the same peon later rewriting the same chalk lines from a notebook, a little clock with a plus sign showing it costs extra time. An examiner in her 50s with a saree and a bunch of keys walks down the aisle checking papers. Bright, slightly dusty daylight, quiet and focused mood. Labels: "GRADIENTS" pointing at an answer sheet, "OPTIMIZER STATES" pointing at the two rough sheets, "CHECKPOINTING" beside the peon wiping the board.

key: Compressing a family photo album for
name: ch07_photo_album_quantization_levels
alt: A family photo shown at high, medium and lowest quality, with faces blurring at the lowest, beside a sketch artist who draws faces well in three shades.
scene: A row of four framed portraits on a living-room wall in an Indian home, with a sofa and a potted money plant below, and a grandfather in a cardigan holding a phone, comparing them. All four show the same family group: grandparents seated, parents standing behind, two children in front, at a festival. FRAME 1: crisp and detailed, every face sharp. FRAME 2: very slightly softer, almost identical. FRAME 3: faces blurred into blocky smudges, the children unrecognisable, with a small frowning emoji tag on the frame. FRAME 4, set a little apart on the right: a pencil sketch using only three shades of grey, black, mid-grey and white, yet every face is clear and expressive. Beside it a sketch artist in his 30s with a beret, kurta and a charcoal pencil behind his ear stands proudly, with a small inset showing him practising with just three pencils from his early days. Small slider icons under frames 1 to 3 show the quality setting going down. Soft evening lamp light, nostalgic mood. Labels: "HIGH" under frame 1, "LOWEST" under frame 3, "TRAINED 3-SHADE" under frame 4.

key: Mixed precision is keeping an exact
name: ch07_piggy_bank_master_weights
alt: A child's one-rupee coins bounce off a piggy bank that only takes ten-rupee notes, while her sister keeps an exact notebook tally.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves in a child's bedroom in an Indian home with a study table and a school bag. LEFT panel: a girl of about eight with two plaits and a school pinafore tries to drop a small one-rupee coin into a quirky piggy bank whose slot is shaped like a long banknote; the coin bounces off and rolls away, and a little calendar beside her shows many days passing with nothing inside the bank, a big zero bubble above it. RIGHT panel: her older sister, about twelve, with glasses and a ponytail, sits at the desk writing in a small notebook where each day gets a tally mark, the tallies adding up neatly down the page; only when the tally reaches ten does she exchange coins for a single note and slide it into the piggy bank with a satisfied grin. A tiny arrow shows tallies turning into a note. Warm afternoon light through curtains, toys on the shelf. Labels: "LOW PRECISION" at the top of the left panel, "MASTER COPY" over the notebook on the right.

key: Retraining a cricket team for T20 by
name: ch07_cricket_t20_partial_vs_adapters
alt: A coach swaps only the last batters in a team, which barely helps, while another coach gives every player a short T20 drill.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both set on a sunny cricket practice ground with nets, stumps and a pavilion. LEFT panel: a coach in a tracksuit stands beside a vertical batting-order board with eleven name slots shown as simple player silhouettes; he swaps only the bottom three silhouettes for new players who jog in with kit bags, while the top eight stay unchanged in grey. A small gauge beside the board shows only a tiny improvement. RIGHT panel: a different coach blows a whistle while all eleven players, in matching practice jerseys, do a short identical drill in parallel lanes: quick sprints between cones, ramp shots against a bowling machine, and fast throws at the stumps; each player has a small lightning-bolt badge clipped to his jersey, showing a tiny addition to everyone. A larger gauge beside them swings well into the green. A water cooler, cones and kit bags dot the ground. Bright afternoon sun, energetic mood. Labels: "PARTIAL FINETUNE" at the top of the left panel, "ADAPTERS" at the top of the right panel.

key: A plug-in adapter for a foreign socket
name: ch07_travel_plug_adapter
alt: A small removable travel adapter sits between a foreign wall socket and a charger plug, with current flowing through it, while the house wiring stays untouched.
scene: A close-up, slightly angled view of a hotel room wall abroad with an unfamiliar socket shape, a cutaway section of the wall showing the original copper wiring behind it, drawn calmly and wrapped in a soft blue frost tint to show it is untouched. Plugged into the socket is a small chunky travel adapter, drawn clearly as a separate box, and into it goes a charger plug from home with a three-pin shape and a cable leading to a phone on the bedside table. A glowing current line flows from the wall wiring, takes a short detour through the adapter box, where a tiny gear icon shows it converting, and then into the charger. Beside the wall, an Indian traveller in her 30s, wearing a travel jacket with a suitcase covered in stickers, smiles as her phone starts charging, holding a second spare adapter between her fingers to show it is removable. A tiny stopwatch on the adapter box shows a small added delay. Warm bedside lamp light, cosy mood. Labels: "FROZEN WIRING" on the wall cutaway, "ADAPTER" on the plug-in box.

key: a secret hand signal you invented and
name: ch07_hand_signal_soft_prompt
alt: A manager tells an employee be polite and brief in words in one panel, and in another uses a secret trained hand signal that the employee understands perfectly.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, set at a showroom counter of an Indian furniture store. The same two people in both halves: a manager in her 40s in a smart blazer over a kurta, and a young salesman in his early 20s with a store polo shirt and name badge, facing a well-dressed customer couple. LEFT panel: the manager leans in and whispers a long spoken instruction, drawn as a wordy speech bubble with lines of text; the salesman looks slightly unsure, sweating a little, and greets the customers awkwardly. RIGHT panel: from across the room the manager makes a small, unusual hand signal, two fingers tapping her wrist, which is glowing faintly; a dotted line carries it straight to the salesman, who immediately shifts into the perfect warm tone, bowing slightly with a gentle smile, and the customers beam. A small inset at the top right shows the two of them earlier practising the signal many times in a training room, with tally marks on a whiteboard. Other staff in the background look at the signal, puzzled, clearly unable to read it. Warm showroom lighting. Labels: "HARD PROMPT" at the top of the left panel, "SOFT PROMPT" at the top of the right panel.

key: An experienced Carnatic singer learning
name: ch07_carnatic_singer_low_rank
alt: An experienced classical singer needs only a few new phrases to learn a new raga, while a beginner beside her must learn everything from scratch.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves in a traditional music room in a South Indian home with a swing, brass lamps, a tanpura leaning against the wall and a framed picture of a veena. LEFT panel: an experienced Carnatic singer in her 50s, silk saree, jasmine in her hair, a big red bindi, sits cross-legged on a mat with perfect posture, one hand keeping tala on her thigh. A thin booklet with just three short new musical phrases, drawn as three small wavy lines, lies open before her. Behind her, a huge glowing background of skills, breath, pitch, rhythm and voice, is already in place, drawn as a large solid pillar. Only three small new arrows join that pillar. RIGHT panel: a beginner, a nervous teenage boy in a kurta, sits before a teacher with a tower of thick books, a metronome, a breathing chart and a pitch pipe stacked high around him, dozens of arrows pointing at him from every direction, and he looks overwhelmed. Warm lamp light and a devotional, serene mood on the left, a busier slightly chaotic mood on the right. Labels: "FEW DIRECTIONS" at the top of the left panel, "EVERYTHING" at the top of the right panel.

key: A fixed renovation budget for a flat
name: ch07_flat_renovation_lora_rank
alt: Two versions of a four-room flat with the same budget: one room fully redone and three untouched, or all four rooms lightly refreshed.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, each half showing a cutaway floor plan of the same small Indian apartment from above at a three-quarter angle, with four rooms: a living room, a kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom. The same couple in their 30s stands at the door of each, holding a cloth bag of money of the same size, a rupee badge on it. LEFT panel: the living room is lavishly redone with a new false ceiling, wallpaper, a chandelier and a polished floor, while the kitchen, bedroom and bathroom remain old and shabby with peeling paint and a dripping tap; the couple look half pleased. RIGHT panel: all four rooms have a light refresh: fresh paint, a new curtain, a new tap, a small new lamp, everything looking evenly better; the couple smile widely. A painter on a ladder in the right half holds a paint roller with a dial on the paint can marked from pale to strong, set to a middle intensity, showing how strongly the new paint shows over the old walls. Bright morning light, cheerful mood. Labels: "ONE ROOM" at the top of the left panel, "ALL ROOMS" at the top of the right panel, and "ALPHA" beside the paint-can dial.

key: small spice boxes for each regional
name: ch07_thali_kitchen_spice_box_adapters
alt: A thali restaurant kitchen keeps one big base of dal and rice and swaps small regional spice boxes per order, while a second corner keeps pre-mixed full pots for each style.
scene: A wide view of a large Indian thali restaurant kitchen. In the centre, a big shared cooking station with huge pots of plain dal and rice, which a head cook in his 40s with a white cap and apron is serving. Hanging on a rack above him are three small labelled steel spice boxes, each with a tiny regional icon: a dhokla for one style, a turban for another, and a coconut tree for a third. The head cook swaps the spice box per order: a dotted arrow shows him unclipping one box and clipping another as order slips arrive on a rail with the same three icons. In the right corner of the kitchen, a second cook in a blue apron stands beside three separate giant pots, each already fully mixed for one style, crowded and taking up lots of space; one pot is barely used, with a spider web on the ladle, showing waste when many styles are needed. Steam, copper vessels, bright tube lights and a busy service window to the dining hall in the background. Labels: "BASE MODEL" on the big dal and rice pots, "ADAPTERS" beside the rack of spice boxes, "MERGED" above the three full pots in the corner.

key: Storing your winter clothes vacuum
name: ch07_vacuum_packed_clothes_qlora
alt: A woman unpacks a vacuum-sealed bag of winter clothes from the loft to wear one set, while overflow bags go to the neighbour's spare room.
scene: A cutaway view of a middle-class Indian home on a winter morning. TOP: a wooden loft above the bedroom door holds rows of flat vacuum-sealed plastic bags of sweaters and shawls, squeezed thin and neatly stacked. MIDDLE: a woman in her 30s, wrapped in a thin dupatta and shivering slightly, stands on a step stool and takes down one bag; in the next small moment beside her, she cuts it open and the sweater puffs out to full size with a little whoosh, a small clock icon showing it took a few minutes. She then wears a cosy red cardigan. A narrow cupboard beside her has lots of free space. RIGHT: through an open door to the next flat, a friendly neighbour in her 60s in a woollen shawl holds the door of her spare room open, where a few extra overflow bags from the cupboard sit on a bed, connected by a dotted arrow from the woman's crowded cupboard. Soft cold morning light, a tea kettle steaming on the side. Labels: "4-BIT STORAGE" above the loft, "UNPACK TO USE" beside the puffed-up sweater, "PAGED OVERFLOW" over the neighbour's spare room.

key: Three cousins each learn one dish in
name: ch07_three_cousins_model_merging
alt: Three cousins each learn one dish from a different relative, then write a single family recipe book together.
scene: A two-row composition. TOP ROW, three side-by-side scenes happening at the same time in three different family kitchens, linked by a thin parallel-lines symbol: a teenage boy cousin in a cricket jersey learns biryani from a grandmother in a white saree, layering rice in a big handi; a girl cousin in a school uniform learns dosa from an aunt in a nine-yard saree, spreading batter on a tawa; another boy cousin in a hoodie learns rasgulla from an uncle in a kurta, rolling white chenna balls into syrup. BOTTOM ROW: all three cousins sit together around a dining table, laughing, pens in hand, writing into one thick shared notebook that has three tabs, each with a small dish icon; three dotted arrows come down from the top kitchens into the notebook. Beside them, two small greyed-out insets for comparison: in one, a single exhausted cousin stands between three stoves at once, frazzled; in the other, the same cousin learns the dishes one after another while the first dish fades from a thought bubble. Warm homely light, festive and affectionate mood. Labels: "PARALLEL" over the top row, "MERGED BOOK" over the shared notebook.

key: Ensembling is asking three doctors for
name: ch07_three_doctors_ensemble_vs_merge
alt: A patient pays three doctors for three opinions on each visit, compared with one doctor who has absorbed all three doctors' knowledge.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, the same patient in both halves: a man in his 40s with a muffler, a sling bag and a worried face, holding a medical file. LEFT panel: three consultation desks in a row, each with a different doctor, a young woman with a stethoscope, an older man with a beard, a middle-aged man with glasses; the patient walks from desk to desk, and three separate receipts with rupee signs stack up in his hand; above the desks, three opinion bubbles show two tick marks and one cross, combined in a small voting box with a majority tick. RIGHT panel: a single calm doctor in her 40s sits at one desk; three small ghostly outlines of the three previous doctors merge into her as glowing trails, and her head has a single combined thought bubble with a tick. The patient holds just one receipt and smiles with relief. Clean clinic background with a weighing scale, a wall chart of the human body and an examination bed. Soft clinic light. Labels: "ENSEMBLE" at the top of the left panel, "MERGE" at the top of the right panel.

key: Flying from Delhi to New York: the
name: ch07_great_circle_slerp
alt: A globe shows a curved flight path along the surface between two cities, while a straight dotted line tunnels through the Earth.
scene: A large illustrated globe floating in a deep blue starry space, tilted to show the northern hemisphere, with continents in soft green and brown and oceans in blue. A small plane icon sits at a pin over north India on the left, and a second pin marks the east coast of North America on the right. A bright orange arc curves smoothly over the top of the globe along its surface, past the far north, with a little airplane flying along it, showing the great-circle route. A straight dashed grey line connects the two pins directly, cutting through the inside of the globe; a cutaway section of the globe shows the line tunnelling through the molten core with a small worried mole poking out. At the bottom, an Indian traveller in her 30s with a backpack and a passport sits at an airport window seat, looking at an in-flight map screen that shows the curved route. Cool cosmic light on the globe, a warm cabin glow at the bottom. Labels: "SLERP" along the orange arc, "LINEAR" along the dashed straight line.

key: Two editors mark changes on the same
name: ch07_two_editors_ties_merge
alt: Two editors mark the same manuscript with big important edits and many small comma tweaks; the merged copy keeps only the big edits.
scene: A newspaper office desk in an Indian city, seen from above at an angle, under a desk lamp. On the left, an editor in her 40s in a cotton kurta and reading glasses marks a printed manuscript with a red pen: two big bold red strokes rewrite whole sentences, and a swarm of tiny red commas and dots are sprinkled across every line. On the right, a second editor in his 50s with a bald head and a sleeveless sweater marks an identical copy with a blue pen: two different big blue rewrites, and his own swarm of tiny blue commas. In the middle, a young sub- editor in her 20s with a ponytail holds up a fresh clean third copy; dotted arrows carry only the two big red rewrites and the two big blue rewrites into it, while the swarms of little commas fall into a wastepaper basket below, colliding and tangling with each other in mid-air. The merged copy looks neat and clear with a green tick. Piles of newspapers, a teacup and a pencil holder clutter the desk. Warm lamp light in an otherwise dim newsroom. Labels: "BIG EDITS" pointing at the merged copy, "TRIMMED" over the falling commas.

key: Building a taller apartment block by
name: ch07_stacked_building_upcycling
alt: Construction workers lift a copy of a building on top of itself, removing a few floors at the joint, while a side panel shows one kitchen split into several specialist kitchens with a head waiter.
scene: A wide construction scene in an Indian city skyline, with the main image on the left and a smaller panel on the right. LEFT: a mid-rise apartment block stands on its plot, and a giant crane lifts an identical copy of the same block high into the air to place it on top; at the joint, a few floors are drawn as transparent and being removed by workers in hard hats, so the plumbing pipes line up, shown by matching blue pipe ends meeting. Below, interior workers with paint rollers and electricians on ladders finish the new upper floors so they become livable. A site engineer in a white hard hat and a reflective vest checks a blueprint showing the doubled building. RIGHT panel, separated by a thin line: a single restaurant kitchen turns into several smaller specialist kitchens side by side, a tandoor station, a chinese wok station, a dosa station, a sweets station, with a head waiter in a black vest at the front reading order slips and pointing each order to the right kitchen with arrows. Bright, dusty midday light, busy mood. Labels: "DEPTH UP" beside the stacked building, "MOE" above the right panel, "ROUTER" under the head waiter.

key: Combining two tiffin boxes by taping
name: ch07_tiffin_concat_vs_sum
